program_code: AST (Division of Astronomical Sciences, Directorate for Mathematical and Physical Sciences)

risk_flags.detail: Inclusion of voluntary committed cost sharing is prohibited.
No restrictions or limits on the number of proposals per organization or per PI or co-PI.

risk_flags.check: Documents requiring signature / institution must submit
risk_flags.detail: Unaffiliated individuals are not eligible to submit; the organization submits (AOR) and award notification goes to the submitting organization.
Anticipated Type of Award: Standard Grant or Continuing Grant (assistance award, not a contract); standard NSF award conditions apply.

risk_flags.check: Acceptance of terms & conditions upon submission
Controlled unclassified information (CUI) or classified information

dates_and_deadlines.date_time: October 01, 2022 - November 15, 2022, due by 5 p.m. submitting organization's local time
dates_and_deadlines.notes: Sponsor states: October 1 - November 15, Annually Thereafter.

eligible_institutions.type: Categories of proposers identified in the NSF PAPPG, Chapter I.E

eligible_institutions.compliance_requirements: Not eligible to submit proposals in response to this solicitation.

eligible_individuals.conditions: Who May Serve as PI: There are no restrictions or limits.

award_information.number_of_awards: 100 (about 100 projects will be funded per year, pending availability of funds)

required_components.name: Project Description
required_components.description: Must demonstrate the astronomical context of the work (proposals that do not are returned without review) and clearly place the work within the appropriate field of study.

required_components.name: Project Summary
required_components.description: Must clearly place the work within the appropriate field of study (review panels: EXC, GAL, PLA, SAA).

required_components.name: Collaborators & Other Affiliations (COA)
required_components.description: Collaborators & Other Affiliations Information per the PAPPG, with one solicitation-specific deviation.
required_components.special_requirements: Table 4: list only the first three (3) co-authors; instructions for Tables 1, 2, 3 and 5 are unchanged from the PAPPG.

optional_components.name: Subaward Documents (if applicable)
optional_components.description: Budget (excel); RR Subaward Budget form if applicable; Budget Justification; Senior Key Personnel Documents — sponsor SciENcv Biosketch + Current & Pending; Specific Scope of Work; AOR-signed Letter of Commitment if on the FDP list, or a completed UI subrecipient Commitment form; Facilities/Equipment if applicable.

submission_details: Proposals may be submitted via Research.gov or Grants.gov (PAPPG guidelines apply for Research.gov; the NSF Grants.gov Application Guide applies for Grants.gov). Collaborative proposals submitted as separate submissions from multiple organizations must be submitted via Research.gov.
special_requirements: Accomplishment-Based Renewal proposals will not be accepted and will be returned without review.

Research in Undergraduate Institutions (RUI) and Computational and Data Enabled Science and Engineering (CDS&E) proposals are accepted and must meet the AAG requirements, guidelines and deadlines; CDS&E proposals must explicitly address the CDS&E program goals within the 15-page Project Description.
Under an MOU, NSF may share information from proposals with NASA for consideration of joint funding and may invite NASA employees to observe merit review panels.
formatting_requirements: Prepare the proposal according to PAPPG Chapter II.D.2, using the version of the PAPPG in effect on the proposal's due date, unless this solicitation specifies different instructions. Sponsor default (NSF) fills the rest: Fonts — Arial (not narrow), Courier New, or Palatino Linotype at 10pt+, or Times New Roman / Computer Modern 11pt+. Margins ≥1 inch all sides (incl. headers/footers). Line spacing ≤6 lines/inch. Page size 8.5×11 in.

mandated_sections.name: NASA data justification (labeled section; only for proposals with an extensive effort to model or analyze NASA mission or archive data)
mandated_sections.requirements: Explain why NASA data are required to advance the scientific goals of the NSF proposal.

budget_requirements.funding_limits: Not Applicable (Other Budgetary Limitations: Not Applicable).

important_notes: Proposals that predominantly exploit NASA data or resources are expected to be submitted to NASA; contact a cognizant AST program officer about the suitability of the proposal for AAG.
